Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J10/J10nA158.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun. Miyun Yuanwu owns the retained deployment: raises the whole line in hall, Dongshan's going east and west to the place of no blade of grass, Shishuang's why not say step out the gate and it is grass, and the old master's extension that even not going out it is grass everywhere, then judging that this crew of old augers meant to illumine the original lot and instead turned it into something extra, so that later folk bargain over east and west, a thousand li and ten thousand, out the gate and not out, grass and not-grass, he snatches up the staff and draws one stroke to cut it through for them all.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB190.xml). Dharma Platform of Chan Master Shiyu. Shiyu Mingfang owns the retained deployment: at the feast where the patron asks why the mountain monk only sings long and short, striking the staff on the hundred-blessings body that folk seek outside, sings the coming-road song, that the road they came by has no dark recess, believe that step out the gate it is grass, and why do they say not going out is also grass, meet a dead snake on the road, do not kill it, carry it home in the bottomless basket, then what.

Senses.Explanation: The rear half of the pair Dongshan set at summer's end, and the line of masters who wore it after Shishuang first said it. Shishuang Qingzhu, hiding among the potters of Liuyang after the persecution years, answers the monk who carries Dongshan Liangjie's word of the ten-thousand li without a blade of grass with the five graphs alone, step out the gate and it is grass, and when it is carried back Dongshan rules it the word of a teacher of a thousand five hundred, while Wansong Xingxiu, who keeps the record, ranks its principle-talk past Jiashan's and still grants the gate-display a hundred-step lead, Foyan Qingyuan raises the same word in hall and answers it with the same five graphs himself, idling the old man of Longmen who north would bow to Wuzhu and south climb the Five Elders, hair already white, regretting he did not return sooner, Dahui Zonggao raises the pair and rules that the ten-thousand li just go that way, stepping out the gate it is grass, each with his own warrant, the stump-keeping man under the clear wind watching the cool hare recede into spring-grass green, and Xutang Zhiyu at the opening of the bag at retreat's end makes dry thatch take fire, one leaf falling and the whole sky autumn, a speck of dust rising and the whole earth gathered in. Miyun Yuanwu raises the whole line of old augers, Shishuang's word and the old master's extension that even not going out the gate it is grass everywhere, and judging that they meant to illumine the original lot and instead turned it into something extra, so that later folk bargain over going east and west, a thousand li and ten thousand, out the gate and not out, grass and not-grass, he draws one stroke with the staff and cuts it through for them all, Gulin Qingmao at the mutual-invitation close tells the brothers that early autumn and late summer, going east and west, to the place of no blade of grass, step out the gate and it is grass, so where then will you go, the ancients having opened the great road through to heaven, and next day at the invitation rite they may go east and west as they please, only not to the place of no blade of grass, Tianyin Yuanxiu turns the five graphs on Yunju's mountain-surveying, that anyone hunting a mountain to live on should study Yunju's manner of treading the hills, for were it not so, out the gate it is grass stretching everywhere, the two of them meeting like a pearl rolling in the bowl, and Shiyu Mingfang sings the coming-road song at the feast, that the way they came has no dark recess, believe that step out the gate it is grass, and why do they say not going out is also grass, meet a dead snake on the road, do not kill it, carry it home in the bottomless basket.
